newsitem.title: UK: UK trawlerman finds message in bottle 82 years on.
newsitem.headline: UK trawlerman finds message in bottle 82 years on.

text.p: Scottish trawlerman John Forman thought little of it when his boat dredged up an old bottle from the seabed -- until he looked inside and found a note written more than 82 years ago.
Forman said on Thursday the bottle had been thrown into the sea in 1914 by scientists working for the Scottish Fishery Board as part of an experiment to chart currents around the British coast.
Forman found the bottle while towing a trawl net 35 miles (50 km) east of the Shetland Isles off the northern coast of Scotland.
Inside was a yellowing card offering a one pound reward to whoever returned the bottle so scientists could use its position to work out which way the tidal streams flow in the North Sea.
Forman said he would be claiming the money.
